name: VTF Token
fix_description: In getUserCanMint, do not use super.balanceOf(account) (instant balance) to calculate rewards. Use a recorded balance that is set at deposit/transfer time, or reset userStartTime on every balance increase so that newly received tokens (e.g., via flashloan) have zero elapsed time and produce zero rewards.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is multi-step and protocol-specific: it uses a flash loan, token swaps, timestamp manipulation, mass deployment of helper contracts, and chained reward-claim calls to amplify an accounting flaw. While the PoC is not extremely long, understanding why repeated create2-based contracts and updateUserBalance calls extract value requires reading the target token’s custom reward logic rather than spotting a simple generic bug.
